title: The Note Let Go Early

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: A note let go before the note has finished is a letting-go all the same. The river does not ask the hand why it stopped, and the hand does not ask the river why it went on.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Clay Yard, told over the flat stone by the well in Bone's last working week

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and fifteen to three hundred and seventeen days, six months and one hundred and thirty-five to one hundred and thirty-seven days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. No present-tense break and no tagged memory; the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone, never a break in the narration. That register takes the body in its old order each morning — crust two inches from the ear, gone leathery in the dry kiln heat with its corner standing a hair off the wool and its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the small bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and reads the world the way a trauma bay is read, by the small sounds first because the small sounds do not lie. He knows a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before he is worse, and that the infant's want of the crust is louder than the surgeon's knowing and neither wins; the argument is the work. Three counts in three places that do not become one, since agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands: the carried fire's four low pulls with its fifth unpaid and its payer unnamed; the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot; the river's water over water, a low thing over a lower thing, not numbered among the hearings. Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty; the heard bell stays in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night; the told figure beside the paid with four arithmetics of the year now behind one printed figure, Bone's first reading gone up the clay road in Berr Clay's locked box behind Frost's three, one in twelve printed and unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid and no signature on the space between, four readings four and not one account with the finding on a place of its own and no payer. The stayed-at-the-inch object of Bone 15 stands as one object on its own place on the sixth and is not made again; the returned half-check of Bone 8 stays the fourth of four held changes on four places and not a rule. The dressed grain lies covered under wool at the rack end, turned with a progressively lighter touch and read over on Bone 10 by a number that does not know what it cost. The twice-mended pot lifts on Sella's thumb where the wire crosses the crack with the crack left showing; the widow's mark is touched at no hour because a morning, a hearth, a yard and a bed are not openings; Ilva's notched strip stays unread in her sleeve. On Bone 17 a new small object is laid on its own place: an intake let go before the river's note has finished, held apart from the staying and the four held changes and standing up as no doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stands.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Sixteenth Morning of Bone
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{315}{Bone 16, Sixthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Sixthday with no market, Cross or bell. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on the two hundred and fourth answer as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking; do not recap Chapter 87. Carry the count from three hundred and fourteen to three hundred and fifteen exact, six months and one hundred and thirty-five days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and fifteen days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Nothing from Bone 10 through 15 comes in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment — not the reading, not the four arithmetics, not the returned half-check, not the staying at the inch. Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, its corner standing a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the small bare wrist-joint, as at the end of a written line; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody here will perform. He knows the composed face that is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before worse and must be warmed from outside and slowly; he wants the crust lifted two inches and the thread wiped and cannot close two inches on the pot handle set beyond his reach. Both true, the second louder, the argument the work (T060/T086). Three counts in three places that do not become one (T061/T082). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it, counts small intake, hold and letting-go under her breath toward no opening, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf with the charcoal unread, her lips along a two-gapped row with neither gap figured, one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze and her hand half over nothing; she lifts the twice-mended pot with her thumb first where the wire crosses the crack and says both proverbs to the pot and the fire with the crack left showing, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed. The widow's mark hangs untouched because a morning and a hearth are not openings; five openings in five months are five and not a rule (T058/T079/T100). Four arithmetics of the year sit behind one printed figure with the finding on a place of its own and no payer, not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the stayed-at-the-inch object or his own gaps — the edges nearly touch and the finger goes between (T015/T041/T047). The stayed-at-the-inch object remains one object on its own place, one staying and not a habit, not made again and not a fifth held change. The hand comes up an inch toward the river's note, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his and lets it go whole on the same note — answer two hundred and five, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment with no payer named — and comes straight down and lays itself back against the fold. The file lies open on the towel with every gap left gap.

scenes.title: What the Yard Went Around on Bone 16
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 315, no new dated heading: afternoon through the going of the light and into the small hours at the Clay Yard, yard well, flat stone, rack end, kindling, flagstones, wheel-shed edge, bed, boards and towel. Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate, gives the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, sets him level and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number: the clean dark line at the Vail corner and the finer grey hairline beside it called the thaw, unswept both; the space beneath the lowest rack where the broken birth-slates lie; the round ring where the shallow clay pan once stood with no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word; the water in the trough; the field's empty place out on the worked strips; and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out — no eighth likeness stood up as a row and no number spoken over the going (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T060/T086). Three coverings at the well stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause: the stayed frost gone off the north lip while the yard looked elsewhere, the skin on the trough, the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone out of the path of feet (T083/T085 held). The dressed grain lies under wool at the rack end, turned with a progressively lighter touch and given no figure, read over by a number that does not know what it cost (T077). Bone's hunts and repairs go on as directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures: a man with a cracked jar in a rope sling asks what the mending of Bone will want and a woman at the well tells him to ask the pot, and the pot, being a pot, says nothing; another, shifting a burden from one collarbone to the other, says the cost is the weather and goes off toward the clay road with nobody weighing what he carries and nobody opening a slate. Tarn is at the kindling with the small knife at the very edge of its sill where it can be checked and where it can slip, six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence; he tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count and brings the sentence about an ear under this roof worth more than the debt that holds it to the word that would call the loan, stopping there with no figure and no name as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end; the Seed 16 breath stays unspent with its small interval at the top of each reach, chest tight since the dark, Ash worked into the knuckle creases, pale clip-ring at the left wrist holding light (T036/T076/T006). Jorra comes off the wheel-shed with meal-fine grey slate dust ground past the bent finger, dusty and clean forearms parted as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the full note known three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it from a High Kiln master who would call it early, and puts the bent finger into the cold iron of the damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, reading one piece of iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies (T035/T031/T062). On the flagstones his stroke goes over the shallow bright patch without the half-check; the returned half-check of Bone 8 stays with the Day 161 damper fraction, the Day 166 shelf beat and the Frost 5 returned beat as four held changes on four places, not a rule, no fifth likeness made a cause, and the staying at the inch is not made a fifth of them (T062/T035/T031, T061/T082). The burned slate stands at five with no sixth, no witness and no hand at the flame; the row at five askings with no witness, the well-saying at three shapings, the shut-room tellings at two, the pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart, nine hands with Ilva's ninth and no tenth, the heard bell in its square, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth (T101, T080, T064, T078, T050/T051, T033/T034 held). At the going of the light the hand takes a small intake and lets it go whole on the river's note — answer two hundred and six — and comes straight down; it does not stay and it does not let go early. Nothing on the sixteenth was opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended.

scenes.title: Before the Note Had Done
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and second dated \daymark{316}{Bone 17, Seventhday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the roof into first light of an ordinary Seventhday with no market, Cross or bell. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Bone 15 or 16 is brought in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment. Carry three hundred and fifteen to three hundred and sixteen exact, six months and one hundred and thirty-six days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and sixteen days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order: the crust gone stiffer and leathery two inches from the ear, its corner a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a written line; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody in this house will perform. The composed face is not composure; a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before worse; he wants the crust lifted two inches and the thread wiped, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the argument the work (T060/T086). The chapter's one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T060/T086, T061/T082): in the morning the hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note, takes its small intake and lets it go whole — but lets it go before the note has finished, while the low sound is still going under the finger's-width door. The surgeon reads it as a tourniquet released before the bleeding has quite stopped, a clamp taken off a moment too soon; the infant reads a hand that gave up before it was done wanting the crust. Both are true, neither wins, and the argument has a second body in the air. He files it as answer two hundred and seven on a place of its own on the sixth, a finger between it and the stayed-at-the-inch object and a finger between it and every other object there: not a reach, not a second staying, not a habit, not a fifth held change, not a seventh hearing, not a tenth stopping, not a payment and not a payer, and not to be made again. One early letting-go is an object; two would stand up and call themselves a rule, and a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stood. Sella's grammar holds at the fire and the shelf: fire before basket, instruction to wool, pot, broom and running water and never the basket, charcoal unread beneath her finger on top of the shelf, two gaps unfigured, one glance at the clay jar and the hand half over nothing, twice-mended pot lifted with the thumb first where the wire crosses the crack, both proverbs to the pot and the fire, crack left showing, widow's mark untouched because a morning is not an opening (T058/T079/T100, T009/T013/T092). Four arithmetics stand behind one printed figure with the finding on a place of its own and no payer, not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the staying, the early letting-go or his own gaps — the edges nearly touch and the finger goes between (T015/T041/T047). Three counts stay three and the six hearings keep the seventh place empty (T061/T082). The file lies open on the towel with every gap left gap.

scenes.title: I Keep the Count
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: afternoon of Bone 17 through the going of the light and into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the yard well and its flat stone, the kindling, flagstones, wheel-shed edge, bed, boards and towel. Sella carries him down at the half-pace and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). At the yard well Ilva draws with the pail against her knee, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and the finer grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb which she does not scrub out. Asked what the firings of Bone have taken, her hand goes toward her sleeve and stays; the short strip of notched birch bark is not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the charcoal under the shelf, the cord, the open slate a pace away, the knot-string or the ownerless saying, and no figure comes off the wood. Her eyes go to the asker and her mouth opens after both, with a half-beat between the looking and the word; she answers the question put and not the one behind it: Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account. She puts the flat of her hand once more on the sleeve and goes back to the pail, and nobody turns twice. The boy files the order of reaching as a ninth record-first hand on a place of its own with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth, files no tenth, makes no figure of the slate's nearness and does not make her a reader of her own keeping (T080 advanced, not paid). She is not Marra, not the soft-handed man, not the soft-cuffed clerk, not Hessa and not the green-mouthed woman at the pot board; no reading has come to her well and the strip stays in her sleeve. The three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between and no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085 held). The month's hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather: a cost asked of a repaired vessel is sent to the pot, which says nothing, and a man come up from the strips with a burden answers the price with the weather, leaving no entry (T077). Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, clip-ring holding light, Ash in the knuckles; his stroke goes over the bright patch without the half-check (T036/T076/T006, T062/T035/T031). Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the full note from a High Kiln master, and sets his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence (T035/T031/T062). The stayed-at-the-inch object stays one object and the early letting-go of the morning stays one object; neither is made again, neither joins the four held changes on four places and neither stands up as a rule (T060/T086, T062/T035/T031). At the going of the light the hand takes a small intake and lets it go whole on the note — answer two hundred and eight — and comes straight down on the same note; the letting-go is not early a second time. The file lies open with every gap left gap.

scenes.title: The Eighteenth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and third dated \daymark{317}{Bone 18, Eighthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the roof into first light of an ordinary Eighthday with no market, Cross or bell. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Bone 16 or 17 comes in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment. Carry three hundred and sixteen to three hundred and seventeen exact, six months and one hundred and thirty-seven days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and seventeen days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order: the crust stiff and leathery two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody will perform; the surgeon's knowing buys nothing at two inches of air while the infant's want of the crust and the thread is louder, both true, neither winning, the argument the work (T060/T086). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells the coals the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it, keeps the charcoal unread beneath her finger on top of the shelf, the two gaps unfigured, lifts the twice-mended pot with her thumb first where the wire crosses the crack and says both proverbs to the pot and the fire with the crack left showing, turns the dressed grain under wool at the rack end with a still lighter touch and gives it no figure, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and touches the widow's mark at no hour because a morning is not an opening (T058/T079/T100, T009/T013/T092, T077). Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; the heard bell in its square beside the told bell; the told figure beside the paid (T061/T082, T078). Four arithmetics behind one printed figure stand on a place of its own with no payer, the figure read still not the figure paid and no signature on the space, four readings four and not one account, the finding not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the stayed-at-the-inch object, the early letting-go or the boy's gaps — the edges nearly touch and the finger goes between (T015/T041/T047). The early letting-go of Bone 17 is carried as one object on its own place and is not repeated; the staying of Bone 15 is one object and not a habit; the four held changes stay four and not a rule (T060/T086, T061/T082, T062/T035/T031). The boy turns out the file the way he once turned instruments out on a towel at the end of a list, laying each thing on its own place and asking nothing of any of it. In the morning the hand comes up an inch toward the river's note, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his and lets it go whole on the same note — answer two hundred and nine — and comes straight down and lays itself back against the fold, a restraint and not a payment with no payer named. He has stopped expecting anybody to tell him what the number counts, which is not the same as not wanting it, and the older man takes a clean satisfaction in the keeping while the infant underneath wants the crust lifted and the thread wiped; both are true and the second is louder and neither wins.

scenes.title: The File Left Open
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 317, Bone 18, the going of the light and the small hours at the Clay Yard, yard well and flat stone, rack end, kindling, flagstones, wheel-shed edge, bed, boards and towel. Bone goes on without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months is corrected; the yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, and the month's hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T077). Three coverings at the well stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between and no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085 held). The returned half-check of Bone 8 stays on the flagstone's own place with the Day 161 damper fraction, the Day 166 shelf beat and the Frost 5 returned beat beside it; four held changes on four places and not a rule, no fifth likeness made a cause, no payer named, and a thing kept by not being made again is still kept. The stayed-at-the-inch object stays one object and not a habit, and the early letting-go of Bone 17 stays one object on its own place and is not made again into a second early letting-go, a rule, a fifth held change or a payer, with a finger between it and the staying and between it and every other object on the sixth (T060/T086, T061/T082, T062/T035/T031). Four arithmetics with their true subtractions ride locked up the clay road in Berr Clay's box toward High Kiln, one in twelve printed and unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid and no signature on the space; four readings are four and not one account, the finding on a place of its own with no payer, not a lesson, grievance, mending or doctrine and not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the two small objects of the hand or the boy's own gaps — the edges nearly touch and the finger goes between (T015/T041/T047). The burned-slate word stands at five with a finger between the fifth and the four; no sixth is due on a day that has not earned one, no witness stands to be asked and no hand is named at any flame; the shut-room tellings stand at two, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the well-saying at three shapings, nine hands with Ilva's strip in her sleeve and no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled, six hearings with the seventh place empty, five openings in five months with the next far off, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101, T080, T036/T076/T006, T050/T051, T033/T034 held). Tarn keeps six at the lip and the unforged collector sentence beside it with no collector up or down the clay road; Jorra's dust and bent finger at the damper and the men unnamed before first grey go unasked about and *he's not Vail* stays sealed; Garl stays in objects with his name unspoken and his tile debt uncalled (T009/T013/T092). At the very end of the day the hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his and lets it go whole on the same low note — answer two hundred and ten, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer — and comes straight down and lays itself back against the fold. Two hundred and ten honest answers stand on the sixth place, each an object and not a power, and neither the number nor the small hand-movings that made it stand up as a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood. Three hundred and seventeen stands exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill or Grath; six months and one hundred and thirty-seven days are told by nobody; the carried fire's fifth is unpaid the same number of days with its payer unnamed; and Garl's name has not been spoken under the roof the same number. Nothing on the eighteenth of Bone was opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended, and the keeping of the number was the only honest work there was to do and bought nothing at two inches of air. Bone 20 (Day 319), the month's second reading, stands two mornings ahead and is not brought into a day that has not earned it. The river's low note goes quiet under the finger's-width door while the silt-clouded plate of ice stands on its flat stone out of the path of feet, and the file lies open on the towel with every gap left gap, and Bone goes on without a boundary drawn — forward into Bone's second reading, with nothing joined, named, opened, called, paid or ended and no payer standing to any of it.
